card.name: Whether/if/or introducing a yes-or-no condition
card.fires_on: The words whether, if, or, and not when they open or continue a yes-or-no condition, such as 'see if', 'determine whether or not', or 'progression or unacceptable toxicity'.

modes.label: whether / if after a checking verb
modes.description: Whether or if follows verbs like tell, see, assess, or determine and introduces a yes/no question.
modes.example: Refer to the insulin infusion pump user manual to see<< if>> APIDRA can be used.

modes.label: or in stop conditions
modes.description: The word or joins alternative conditions, such as disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
modes.example: in the absence of disease progression<< or>> unacceptable toxicity.

modes.label: not in whether or not
modes.description: The word not completes the phrase whether or not.
modes.example: try first to determine whether or<< not>> the following sentences are complete.
